name: Scratchpad Frame
author: AktOn1
description: A frame around the scratchpad (SUPER + S) that slides in and out with it. Forty-eight styles, from clean vector lines to photographed wood, slate and moss and game-UI frames; each scratchpad can have its own style, entrance and exit. Optionally recolour every style from your Omarchy theme and hide the title. Describe a frame in a few words and your own AI picks and colours a style (previewed, then Apply or Discard); optionally it also asks your own image model for a corner ornament (off until you tick it). A bar icon opens the scratchpads overview and a keyboard (hjkl) style menu with groups, a thumbnail and live preview.

barWidget.description: Scratchpads overview; click one to pick its frame style from groups with a live thumbnail, theme colours, title
